description: This PHP source file defines the ConfigHelper class in the OrangeHRM project. The class manages configuration values stored in a database, providing methods to get, set, and delete configuration entries within the Human Resource Management system.

classes.name: ConfigHelper
classes.description: A utility class to manage configuration values stored in the 'hs_hr_config' table of the database. It provides methods for retrieving, setting, and deleting configuration entries, with support for default values and schema management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ConfigHelper with an optional database connection.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Retrieves the current database connection, either the one provided or a default singleton.

methods.name: getSchemaManager
methods.description: Gets the schema manager for inspecting database table schemas.

methods.name: getConfigValue
methods.description: Fetches a configuration value by its name, returning default if not found.

methods.name: setConfigValue
methods.description: Sets or updates a configuration value in the database.

methods.name: deleteConfigValue
methods.description: Deletes a configuration entry from the database and logs the action.
